three-vrm.bundle.js is a single-file build made from:

1. @pixiv/three-vrm 3.5.5 and its dependencies (@pixiv/three-vrm-core,
   -materials-mtoon, -springbone, -node-constraint, -materials-v0compat,
   -materials-hdr-emissive-multiplier, @pixiv/types-vrm-0.0,
   @pixiv/types-vrmc-vrm-1.0). Source: https://github.com/pixiv/three-vrm
   Licence: MIT. Copyright (c) pixiv Inc.

2. GLTFLoader from three.js r165 (three@0.165.0). Source:
   https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js  Licence: MIT (see ../three-LICENSE.txt).

Built with esbuild 0.24.2 from an entry that re-exports both packages, with
the bare "three" import left external so it uses /assets/three.module.min.js
(three.js r165), mapped by an import map on the page.
